title: 第19章 又有新的目标第20章 树林小世界的母女花
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 江渊回到为他新准备的帝子宫时，天已经蒙蒙亮。
不过修仙之人哪有日夜之分，顶多是日日夜夜。
宫殿极大，云雾缭绕，仙鹤盘旋，完全是按照江家最高规格建造的。
他推开寝宫的大门，一股淡淡的幽香传来，是白清雪身上的味道。
只见这位新婚的妻子，正盘膝坐在床榻上，似乎是在修炼，但周身的气息却有些紊乱，显然心不静。
听到开门声，白清雪睁开了眼睛，那双清冷的眸子里，此刻写满了复杂。
她看着走近的江渊，嘴唇动了动，想问什么，却又不知从何问起。
昨晚发生的一切，对她的冲击太大了。
先是这个传闻中的废物帝子，在洞房花烛夜展现出了与传闻完全不符的强悍，让她这个8境问道境的修士都有些招架不住。
然后，更让她震惊的是这个男人，竟然在她面前，从一个毫无修为的凡人，眨眼间就突破到了3境神魄境！
凡人能修炼了？
这简直是颠覆了整个帝仙大世界的铁律！
最关键的一点就是……自己居然怀孕了！
好歹也是8境修士，她不可能察觉不出身体间的变化。
一个晚上？
凡人与身为修士的自己？
这……这太惊人了！
她第一次感觉自己这个夫君，浑身上下都是秘密。
“夫君……你……”白清雪还是忍不住开了口。
“来，亲一个。”江渊走到床边，很自然地坐下，伸手将她揽入怀中，在她光洁的脸蛋上亲了一口。
白清雪的身体微微一僵，
虽然昨晚已有夫妻之实，不过她还是不擅长应对这么主动的男人。
但奇怪的是她心里并没有多少排斥，反而有一丝异样的感觉。
她鼓起勇气，问出了心中的疑惑，“你……你不是凡体吗？为什么……可以修炼了？”
她太想知道答案了。
这不仅关系到她对自己这位夫君的认知，更可能关系到她，以及整个白虎王族的未来。
因为只有这位帝子活得越久，白虎王族才能在对方的庇佑下蓬勃发展。
“哦，你说这个啊。”
江渊一副无所谓的样子，随口说道，“可能是我爹妈的血脉太强了，压制不住，一不小心就觉醒了呗。”
总不能直接告诉你我是靠睡你才得到奖励的吧？那也太禽兽了。
虽然我就是这么干的。
江渊心里嘀咕着。
白清雪显然不信这个说辞。
content_en:
When Jiang Yuan returned to the imperial palace newly prepared for him, it was already dawn.
However, there is no difference between day and night for those who cultivate immortality. At most, there is day and night.
The palace is huge, filled with clouds and mist, and cranes are circling. It was built entirely according to the highest standards of the Jiang family.
He pushed open the door of the palace, and a faint fragrance came, which was the smell of Bai Qingxue.
I saw the newlywed wife sitting cross-legged on the bed, seemingly practicing, but the aura around her was a little disordered, and she was obviously not at peace.
Hearing the sound of the door opening, Bai Qingxue opened her eyes, her cold eyes filled with complexity at the moment.
She looked at Jiang Yuan who was approaching, her lips moved, and she wanted to ask something, but she didn't know where to start.
What happened last night had a great impact on her.
First, the rumored useless emperor showed strength that was completely inconsistent with the rumors on the night of flowers and candles in the wedding room, which made her, a monk in the 8th realm, unable to resist.
Then, what shocked her even more was that this man, in front of her, had broken through from a mortal with no cultivation to the third level of divine soul in the blink of an eye!
Can mortals practice cultivation?
This simply subverts the iron law of the entire world of Emperor Immortal!
The most important thing is... I am actually pregnant!
After all, she was also an eighth-level monk, so it was impossible for her not to notice the changes in her body.
One night?
Mortals and myself as a monk?
This...this is amazing!
For the first time, she felt that her husband was full of secrets.
"Husband... you..." Bai Qingxue couldn't help but speak.
"Come on, give me a kiss." Jiang Yuan walked to the bed, sat down naturally, stretched out his hand to take her into his arms, and kissed her smooth face.
Bai Qingxue's body stiffened slightly,
Although they were married last night, she was still not good at dealing with such a proactive man.
But the strange thing is that there is not much rejection in her heart, but a strange feeling.
She mustered up the courage and asked the doubts in her heart, "You...are you not a mortal? Why...can you practice?"
She wanted to know the answer so badly.
This is not only related to her understanding of her husband, but it may also be related to her and the future of the entire White Tiger Royal Family.
Because only the longer the emperor lives, the White Tiger Royal Family can flourish under his protection.
"Oh, you said this."
Jiang Yuan looked indifferent and said casually, "Maybe my parents' bloodline is too strong and they couldn't suppress it, so they woke up accidentally."
I can't tell you directly that I get rewards for sleeping with you, right? That's too beastly.
Although that's what I do.
Jiang Yuan murmured in his heart.
Bai Qingxue obviously didn't believe this argument.
